bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test "$(realpath "$root")" = /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot || exit 70
stage="$root/.worktrees/userbot-profile-topics-f703"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = 3764ab0737d82db33f42f9accd8b2b6d1af88698 || exit 71
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 72
systemctl --user is-enabled --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 73
test "$(stat -c %a "$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")" = 600 || exit 74
inode="$(stat -c %i "$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")"
python3 "$root/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health || exit 75
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 76
for i in $(seq 1 20); do
 if systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service &&
    test -S "$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock" &&
    python3 "$root/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
 sleep 2
done
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 77
systemctl --user is-enabled --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 78
test "$inode" = "$(stat -c %i "$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")" || exit 79
test "$(stat -c %a "$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")" = 600 || exit 80
test "$(stat -c %a "$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock")" = 600 || exit 81
python3 "$root/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health || exit 82
python3 - "$root" "$stage" <<'PY'
import subprocess,sys,runpy,re
from pathlib import Path
root,stage=map(Path,sys.argv[1:])
db=subprocess.check_output(["docker","ps","--filter","label=com.docker.compose.service=postgres","--format","{{.ID}}"],text=True).splitlines()
if len(db)!=1:sys.exit(83)
sql="""SELECT board_key,message_thread_id,title FROM posting_topics
 WHERE purpose='profile' AND enabled IS TRUE
 ORDER BY CASE board_key WHEN 'area_bbs' THEN 1 WHEN 'video_chat' THEN 2 WHEN 'gay_board' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END"""
raw=subprocess.check_output(["docker","exec",db[0],"psql","-U","gace","-d","gaybbs","-tA","-F",":","-c",sql],text=True).splitlines()
if len(raw)!=3:sys.exit(84)
ids=[]
for board,line in zip(("area_bbs","video_chat","gay_board"),raw):
 parts=line.split(":",2)
 if len(parts)!=3 or parts[0]!=board or "プロフ" not in parts[2] or not parts[1].isdecimal():sys.exit(85)
 tid=int(parts[1])
 if not 1<=tid<=2147483647:sys.exit(86)
 ids.append(tid)
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/"scripts"))
import userbot_resident_ipc
sys.modules["userbot_resident_ipc"]=userbot_resident_ipc
sys.argv=[str(stage/"scripts/userbot_test_client.py"),"profile_topics_by_id","--topic-ids",",".join(map(str,ids))]
runpy.run_path(sys.argv[0],run_name="__main__")
PY
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 87
systemctl --user is-enabled --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 88
python3 "$root/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health || exit 89
echo GAYBBS_THREE_PROFILE_TOPICS_EXACT_ID_E2E_PASS
